sensors.name: light LLIGHT (the light from above, dim in a tunnel)

control_flow: avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70 %: if LEFT sees something, turn left 20°; else if RIGHT sees something, turn right 20°; else call driveInTheDark. Otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if something is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: In a dark tunnel, turn away from a wall close on its left or right, and get through a bending tunnel without touching it.
